test_register_provider: test registering an image generation provider and looking it up by name
test_rejects_non_provider: test that register_provider rejects non-ImageGenProvider instances with TypeError
test_rejects_empty_name: test that register_provider rejects providers with empty name with ValueError
test_reregister_overwrites: test that re-registering a provider with the same name overwrites the previous entry
test_list_is_sorted: test that list_providers returns providers sorted alphabetically by name
test_get_active_provider_single: test get_active_provider returns the single registered provider when only one exists
test_get_active_provider_fal_preferred: test get_active_provider prefers fal provider when multiple providers are registered without config
test_get_active_provider_config_wins: test get_active_provider respects image_gen.provider from config.yaml over default fallback
test_get_active_provider_fallback: test get_active_provider falls back to fal when configured provider is not registered
test_get_active_provider_empty: test get_active_provider returns None when no providers are registered
